limitations: Reported base salaries from each team's Basketball-Reference page; not cap hits, cash or complete legal cap accounting.
Effective dates are not on the source page and stay unknown.
Option markers do not establish exercise or guarantee state; a salary without an option marker is reported, not confirmed guaranteed.
Threshold lines are official markers. Above or below a line is arithmetic on known salaries (a lower bound while any are unknown); no tax bill or legal apron compliance is claimed.
DARKO values are DARKO's market value from its latest published board; surplus is that value minus the reported salary, only for players DARKO lists.
An unknown salary is excluded from known totals and is never zero.
Players on a team's source page but on another roster in the index (for example waived players) are listed separately.
